standard_prerequisites.use: The Beilinson fan P gives an equivalence D(R) -> D_QCoh(O_{P^n}).

standard_prerequisites.use: Condition (2) of that lemma matches the displayed Ext computation.

core_obligations: (2)-(3) by perfect duality; (1) implies (2) by coherence of the tensor product; (2) implies (4) trivially.
(4) implies (1): under the Beilinson equivalence, the cohomology modules of the preimage L compute as the displayed direct sum of H^i(P^n, K tensor O(d)).
Condition (4) makes L compact in D(R) by the in-batch endomorphism-ring card; transfer compactness back and conclude bounded coherence on the regular scheme.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to (4) implies (1) and run the Beilinson transfer; every equality displayed.
difficulty_reason: Four-way equivalence with a Beilinson-type equivalence transfer and an explicit Ext computation; fully displayed.
